translations.web: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
translations.bsb: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
translations.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
